turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Most orders are shipped from our warehouse within 1 to 2 business days.

Once your order has shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email or SMS. Please keep in mind that tracking information can take up to 3 business days to update after shipment. 🙂

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days for orders within the US and Canada. For international destinations, delivery can take 15 to 20 business days from the shipment date. 🙂

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
Unfortunately, once an order is placed, it enters our fulfillment queue right away and cannot be rushed or expedited.

Orders are processed as quickly as possible in the order they are received.
Standard shipping timelines will apply once your package is on its way.

Hope you have an amazing day! 🙂

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Tracking information can take up to 3 business days to update after your order has shipped.

If tracking shows no movement for 8 or more days following a carrier scan, or if you'd like us to look into a specific order for you, please share your order number and email address.
We will be more than happy to check on its status for you! 🙂

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
Unfortunately, once an order has been processed or shipped, we are unable to reroute the package or update the shipping address.

Shipping addresses can only be updated within the initial 30-minute window after placing an order.
Once the package is with the carrier, the delivery address cannot be changed on our end.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
We do not provide financial compensation or refunds for shipping delays, as carrier delivery times can occasionally vary.

Shipping timeframes are estimates, and transit speeds are managed by the carrier once a package has been dispatched.
If your package experiences an unusually long delay or gets stuck in transit, please let us know so we can look into it for you.
